name: Grizzled Den
summary: In Dun Morogh, wendigo packs make their lair in Grizzled Den, southwest of Kharanos.

sections.title: A Frost-Chilled Lair
sections.body: Southwest of Kharanos, Grizzled Den cuts into Dun Morogh’s crags. Wendigo packs make their home in its hollows. These aggressive, ape-like beasts breathe frost at intruders and band together to defend their lair. Hunters brave the cavern for thick wendigo manes, used by craftsmen to line cold chairs and carriage seats with insulating fur.

sections.title: Hidden Treasures
sections.body: Prospectors work copper veins in Grizzled Den’s frozen stone walls. Scouts search its darker corners for discarded footlockers. Deeper in the tunnels, the den’s largest and most vicious predators wait in the shadows.

faq.q: Where is the Grizzled Den located?
aliases: how to get to grizzled den
faq.answer: Grizzled Den lies among Dun Morogh’s snow-covered mountain ridges, southwest of Kharanos.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Grizzled Den?
faq.answer: Ferocious wendigo packs live in Grizzled Den. The white-furred beasts breathe freezing frost and swarm intruders.

faq.q: Why do people venture into the Grizzled Den?
faq.answer: Hunters seek wendigo manes for warm seat covers, while others enter the tunnels to mine copper from the walls.

angles.text: Copper deposits run through Grizzled Den’s outer and inner tunnels, though wendigos make mining there dangerous.
For young dwarven mountaineers training around Kharanos, clearing Grizzled Den is a rite of passage.
